content.text: The licence provisions meet the preferred position in full.

input.quote: 13.3 Customer may transfer its licence rights to an Affiliate or successor in connection with an assignment permitted by Section 24. Vendor shall not revoke or suspend a licence except during a material uncured payment or use breach affecting the licensed item, after notice and a reasonable opportunity to cure.
input.rationale: Section 13 meets the preferred position on every material term. The subscription grant in 13.1 expressly extends to Customer's Affiliates and to contractors acting on their behalf (plus Authorized Users), and 13.2 gives Customer and its Affiliates a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free, fully paid licence for paid-up software and Vendor Technology, with contractor support permitted. The grant is not revocable at Vendor's discretion: 13.3 limits revocation or suspension to a material uncured payment or use breach, after notice and a reasonable opportunity to cure. Licence rights are transferable to an Affiliate or successor under 13.3, backed by Section 24.1, which permits assignment without Vendor consent to an Affiliate or an M&A successor, and 24.4 bars Vendor from terminating or repricing on Customer change of control. No redline required.
